approval_flow: Owners explore directly: sandboxes, prototypes, external experiments, demos and improvements to existing capabilities. A new maintained capability, scenario or significant extension goes to the operator as a proposal packet; an approved proposal becomes a `build` workstream at the proposed scale and is staffed in the next unit.
boundaries:
- Spending money or accepting paid terms.
- Contacting people outside the project.
- Credentials, accounts and private data.
end_state_hint: Say what the operator can do when it is done, including what gets built after approval.
workstream_hint: Keep exploration rows and approved build rows in one table. Exploration that never produces a proposal is not working.
